verdict.rationale: GitLab's first-party docs say custom flows automate team processes and that compliance controls run automatically in every pipeline. Partner listings show event-driven automation through GitLab: Pulumi via GitLab CI deploys on commits to specific branches, and Make uses webhooks and triggers. However, the pack never documents a native, user-defined rule engine that maps events to actions; the event-trigger pieces are implied or come from third parties. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on event-based trigger rules (e.g. pipeline rules, webhooks, flow triggers on issue/MR events), detail on rule conditions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
